scope: DESIGN.md §14 step 3 — R1 live co-authoring (free/bounded/required merge lanes)
meaning: The last open step of the narrowest end-to-end path cannot be implemented without pre-empting owner decisions. Canonical v1 §8.5 specifies three lanes: required (serialized through a contract — ALREADY PROVEN by SCMS-012's conflict path with no partial write), bounded (merge then validate against admission/cardinality — the validator now exists from SCMS-016), and free (convergent merge). But the shape of the free and bounded lanes is exactly what pending proposals P7 (divergence-first branching, traversable-edge whitelist) and P22 (merge as a serializable decision map, refused as a bounded outcome) would change. Implementing convergent merge now would either build a toy that misrepresents the design, or pre-empt a pending disposition.
requiredChange: Owner disposition of P7 and P22 on PR #28 (accept / strike / amend). On acceptance, SCMS-018 becomes Ready with the divergence-first lane; on rejection, it becomes Ready with pure canonical-v1 convergent merge.

scope: the lawful Ready frontier after SCMS-027
meaning: Enumerated rather than asserted. Every candidate and why it is not lawful Ready work: (1) FREE MERGE LANE — P7/P22 on PR #28 would reshape it; building now pre-empts a pending owner disposition (scms-blocker-001). (2) R2 TRANSPORT (outbox, wire, replay, lagged) — P10 proposes exactly this design; the decision half that does NOT depend on it was built instead (SCMS-026 fan-out). (3) S4 CROSS-DOMAIN — external by owner doctrine; requires the owner to nominate an unrelated host project (SCMS-010). (4) UD-2..UD-13 UPSTREAM REPAIRS — in other repositories; several require protected actions (credential rotation UD-7, registry publication UD-3, git init on an owner repo UD-6) or normative authorship for protocols this project does not own (UD-13). (5) FIELD PLANE E5 — entirely unbuilt, but §14's nine steps contain no Field step, so building it is feature expansion, which the standing goal explicitly deprioritizes below maturity. (6) SH-1/2/3/11 (stack, tenancy, erasure-vs-law, GPL boundary) — owner decisions by their own text. (7) SH-4/5/8/9/10 (media, search, authoring surface, import, backup) — need the workload confirmed first; rcp-001 is unconfirmed (#26). (8) SH-6 QUANTITATIVE BUDGETS — measurable only against a real workload; numbers from toy fixtures would over-claim, which the claim register forbids. (9) Envelope body kinds Observation and Topology have no flow yet — Observation is exercised by validation, and Topology is delivery-shaped, so both wait on P10 rather than being dangling declarations of this project's own making. Checked and found NOT to exist: any remaining declaration of this project's own making that lacks a consumer — compensation (SCMS-020), declared types (SCMS-022), the canon write rule (SCMS-023), the wire schema (SCMS-024), the claim register (SCMS-025), and the composed proof (SCMS-027) were each closed this run.
requiredChange: Owner action on one of: PR #28 disposition (unblocks the free lane and R2 transport), #26 recipient confirmation (unblocks the workload-dependent SH entries), nomination of an S4 host, or direction on upstream repairs.
